form.label: Add source
form.slugHint: What goes in the address of its job site:
form.provinceHint: As InfoJobs uses it, e.g. a-coruna

form.added: “{{name}}” added. It's checked every day; you can also search now.
form.websiteHint: For its logo, e.g. acme.com. If it posts its jobs on its own domain, the app takes it from there.

empty.title: You don't follow any company yet

title: Target companies
intro: While it's open, the app checks these companies' job sites every day. What matches your preferences goes to “To extract”.
